findings.description: The new `min` parameter defaults to 1 second, so existing callers that never pass `min` now get a floor of 1 second where the previous minimum was 0.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a caller uses wait_exponential_jitter(initial=0.1, max=10) without min. Before this change, the first wait could be about 0.1 seconds. Now the mechanism is max(max(0, self.min), ...) with self.min=1, so every wait is raised to at least 1 second. Impact: existing retry timing changes silently after an upgrade, which can slow retries for users who relied on sub-second backoff.
